conde: conde — count (= conde; el conde don Remont 'Count Ramón')
follón: follón — arrogant, wicked, boastful man (adj.; el conde es muy follón 'the count is a great braggart'; modern follón = rascal, not 'coward' here)
vanidat: vanidat — vanity, empty boast (fem. noun; dixo una vanidat 'spoke a boast'; = vanidad)
tuertos: tuerto — wrong, injury (noun, pl.; grandes tuertos 'great wrongs'; = agravios, tuertos)
cort: cort — court, royal or lordly household (fem. noun; en mi cort 'in my court'; = corte)
tuerto: tuerto — wrong, injury (noun, sg.; tuerto me tovo 'did me wrong'; = agravio)
tovo: tener — he held, he did (strong preterite 3rd sg.; tuerto me tovo 'he did me wrong'; = tuvo)
firióm: ferir + me — he struck me, wounded me (firió preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic me, final -e dropped; firióm el sobrino 'he struck my nephew'; = me hirió; note the sense: the Cid's men wounded the count's nephew)
enmendó: enmendar — he made amends for (preterite 3rd sg.; non lo enmendó 'he did not make amends'; = enmendó)
córrem: correr + me — he raids, overruns for me/against me (corre present 3rd sg. + enclitic me; córrem las tierras 'he raids my lands'; = me corre)
desafié: desafiar — I defied, formally challenged (preterite 1st sg.; non lo desafié 'I did not challenge him'; = desafié, formal breaking of feudal ties)
nil: ni + le — nor ... him/it (ni 'nor' + enclitic le; non lo desafié nil torné amiztad 'I did not challenge him nor give him back (my) friendship'; = ni le)
torné: tornar — I returned, gave back (preterite 1st sg.; nil torné amiztad 'nor returned (my) friendship', i.e. formally renounced it; = torné)
amiztad: amiztad — friendship (fem. noun; = amistad; Pidal's [a]mi[z]tad, editorial letters; the el before it is the article el for la)
busca: buscar — he seeks, he provokes (present 3rd sg.; quando él me lo busca 'when he goes looking for it from me'; = busca)
demandar: demandar — to demand, claim, ask for (infinitive; ir gelo he demandar 'I shall go and demand it of him'; split future ir + ge + lo + he, = se lo iré a demandar; = demandar)
llegandos: llegar + se — arriving, gathering (gerund llegando + reflexive s(e), Pidal's llegando[s]; a priessa llegandos van 'they keep gathering in haste'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = llegándose)
allegan: allegar(se) — they gather, assemble (present 3rd pl., reflexive se le allegan 'gather to him'; = se allegan, closest se juntan)
adeliñan: adeliñar — they head for, make straight for (present 3rd pl.; adeliñan tras mio Çid 'they make after the Cid'; = encaminan, dirigen)
tras: tras — after, behind (preposition; tras mio Çid 'after the Cid, in pursuit of'; = tras)
penssaron: pensar — they set about, they took care (preterite 3rd pl.; penssaron de andar 'they set about travelling'; pensar de + inf. 'to strive to'; = pensaron)
alcançaron: alcançar — they overtook, caught up with (preterite 3rd pl.; = alcanzaron)
cuydan: cuydar — they think, they expect (present 3rd pl., Pidal's cuyda[n]; se le cuydan tomar 'they expect to seize him'; = creen, piensan)
diçe: deçir — he descends (present 3rd sg.; diçe de una sierra 'he comes down from a ridge'; from Latin descendere, not dezir 'to say'; = desciende; lemma slightly uncertain)
remont: Remont — Ramón, i.e. Ramón Berenguer, count of Barcelona (= Ramón; don Remont)
lês: les + es — to them is (Pidal's circumflexed contraction: les 'to them' + es, ser as perfect auxiliary of venir; venido lês mensaje 'a message has come to them'; = les ha venido; reading probable, not certain)
enbió: enviar — he sent (preterite 3rd sg.; enbió pora allá 'he sent (messengers) over there'; = envió)
digades: dezir — (that) you say, tell (2nd pl. present subjunctive used as command, polite; digades al conde 'tell the count'; = digáis)
tenga: tener — (that) he hold, take (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it ill'; = tenga)
lievo: levar — I take, carry off (present 1st sg.; de lo so non lievo nada 'of what is his I take nothing'; = llevo)
déxem: dexar + me — let him leave me (dexe, present subjunctive 3rd sg., + enclitic me; déxem ir en paz 'let him let me go in peace'; = déjeme)
tódom: todo + me — all of it ... to me (todo + enclitic me, dative 'for me'; tódom lo pechará 'he will pay me for all of it'; = todo me)
pechará: pechar — he will pay, pay for (future 3rd sg.; lo pechará 'he shall pay for it'; = pagará)
sabrá: saber — he will know, find out (future 3rd sg.; sabrá el salido 'the exile will find out'; = sabrá)
desondrar: desondrar — to dishonour, insult (infinitive; vino desondrar 'came to dishonour'; = deshonrar)
connosçe: connoscer — he realises, recognises (present 3rd sg.; essora lo connosçe 'then he realises it'; = conoce)
den: de + en — from there, from it (de 'from' + en = ende 'thence'; non pueden den quitar 'they cannot get out of it'; = de allí; en = ende; uncertain whether den is not simply de + ent)
apart: apart — aside, apart (adverb; apart fazed la ganançia 'set the booty aside'; = aparte)
fazed: fazer — do, make (imperative 2nd pl.; apart fazed 'set aside'; = haced)
guarnid: guarnir — equip, arm yourselves (imperative 2nd pl.; apriessa vos guarnid 'arm yourselves quickly'; = guarneced, armaos)
metedos: meter + vos — put yourselves (imperative 2nd pl. meted + vos, the -d- dropped before the enclitic; metedos en las armas 'get into your arms'; = metedos, ponedos)
dexarié: dexar — he would leave (conditional 3rd sg., -ié ending; non nos dexarié 'he would not let us be'; = dejaría)
apretad: apretar — tighten (imperative 2nd pl.; apretad los cavallos 'tighten the (girths of the) horses'; = apretad)
bistades: vestir — put on (imperative 2nd pl. in -ades with b- spelling; bistades las armas 'put on your arms'; = vestíos de, vestid)
cuesta: cuesta — slope, hillside (fem. noun; cuesta yuso 'down the slope'; = cuesta)
yuso: yuso — down, downward (adverb, Latin deorsum; cuesta yuso 'down the slope'; = abajo)
trahen: traer — they bring, they wear (present 3rd pl., h marking the hiatus; todos trahen calças 'all of them wear hose'; = traen)
elas: e + las — and the (e 'and' + fem. pl. article las; elas siellas 'and the saddles'; = y las)
coçeras: coçera — saddle with a kick-flap or rear guard, apparently ordinary riding saddles (adj./noun, fem. pl., from coz 'kick'; siellas coçeras; meaning uncertain)
amojadas: amojar — slack, loose (past part. fem. pl.; cinchas amojadas; sense debated, also 'wet, soaked'; uncertain)
cavalgaremos: cavalgar — we shall ride (future 1st pl.; = cabalgaremos)
gallegas: gallego — Galician (fem. pl.; siellas gallegas 'Galician saddles', i.e. heavy war saddles; = gallegas)
huesas: huesa — high boot, riding boot (pl.; huesas sobre calças 'boots over hose'; = botas)
devemos: dever — we ought, we are able to (present 1st pl.; devemos vençer 'we ought to defeat, we should be able to beat'; = debemos)
llaño: llaño — plain, level ground (masc. noun; a llaño 'onto the plain'; = llano)
presentémosles: presentar + les — let us present to them (present subjunctive 1st pl. presentemos + enclitic les, the -s of -mos dropped before les; presentémosles las lanças 'let us offer them our lances'; = presentémosles)
firgades: ferir — (that) you strike (present subjunctive 2nd pl., with -g- stem; por uno que firgades 'for each one you strike'; = hiráis)
verá: veer — he will see (future 3rd sg.; verá Remont 'Ramón will see'; = verá)
verenguel: Verenguel — Berenguer, the count's surname (Ramón Berenguer; = Berenguer, with l for r by dissimilation)
tollerme: toller + me — to take from me (toller 'to take away' + enclitic me; por tollerme la ganançia 'in order to take my booty from me'; = quitarme)
adobados: adobar — equipped, ready (past part. masc. pl.; todos son adobados 'all are ready'; = pertrechados, aderezados)
fablado: fablar — spoken (past part.; quando esto ovo fablado 'when he had said this'; = hablado)
presas: prender — taken up, taken (past part. fem. pl.; las armas avién presas 'they had taken up their arms'; = presas)
sedién: seer — they were sitting, they sat (imperfect 3rd pl. of seer 'to sit'; sedién sobre los cavallos 'they sat on their horses'; = estaban sentados, sedían)
fuerça: fuerça — force, host, army (fem. noun; la fuerça de los francos 'the host of the Franks'; = fuerza)
francos: franco — Frank, here a man of the count of Barcelona (Catalans/French of the march; los francos 'the count's host'; = francos)
fondón: fondón — bottom, foot (masc. noun; al fondón de la cuesta 'at the bottom of the slope'; = fondo)
enpleando: empleár — using, plying (gerund; las van enpleando 'they go on plying them'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = empleando)
derrocando: derrocar — throwing down, unhorsing (gerund; a los otros derrocando 'unhorsing others'; = derribando)
vençido: vençer — defeated (past part.; vençido a 'has won', a before the participle as perfect auxiliary; vençido a esta batalla 'he has won this battle'; = ha vencido)
preson: preson — prisoner, captivity (masc. noun; a preson le a tomado 'has taken him prisoner'; = prisión, prisionero)
hi: hi — there, in it (adverb, variant of i from Latin ibi; hi gañó a Colada 'there he won Colada'; = allí)
colada: Colada — the sword Colada, won by the Cid from the count of Barcelona (name of the sword; = Colada)
vale: valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg.; que más vale de mill marcos 'which is worth more than a thousand marks'; = vale)
ondró: ondrar — he honoured, made honoured (preterite 3rd sg.; por o ondró su barba 'through which he honoured his beard'; = honró)
prísole: prender + le — he took him (prís(o) preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic le/lo; prísole al conde 'he took the count prisoner'; = le prendió; exact analysis uncertain)
creenderos: creendero — trusted man, retainer, someone entrusted with a charge (noun, pl., from creer 'to entrust'; sos creenderos 'his trusted men'; = hombres de confianza)
mandava: mandar — he ordered, was ordering (imperfect 3rd sg.; a sos creenderos guardar lo mandava 'he told his trusted men to guard him'; = mandaba)
ajuntavan: ajuntar(se) — they were gathering, assembled (imperfect 3rd pl. in -avan, Pidal's ajunta[van], reflexive sense 'gathered themselves'; = se juntaban)
cozínal: cozina + le — kitchen, meal ... for him (cozina 'cooking, meal' + enclitic le, dative; grant cozínal adobavan 'they prepared a great meal for him'; the -al may instead be el/al; uncertain; = cocina, comida)
adobavan: adobar — they prepared, were preparing (imperfect 3rd pl.; = adobaban, aderezaban)
adúzenle: aduzir + le — they bring to him (aduzen present 3rd pl. + enclitic le; = le traen; aduzir = to bring, lead)
comeres: comer — food, dishes (masc. noun, pl., nominalised infinitive; adúzenle los comeres 'they bring him the dishes'; = comidas)
quiere: querer — he wants (present 3rd sg.; non lo quiere comer 'he will not eat it'; = quiere)
sosañava: sosañar — he was scorning, mocking (imperfect 3rd sg.; a todos los sosañava 'he looked down on them all'; = despreciaba, desdeñaba)
combré: comer — I shall eat (future 1st sg. comré with epenthetic b; non combré un bocado 'I will not eat a morsel'; = comeré)
perderé: perder — I shall lose, let go (future 1st sg.; antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body'; = perderé)
cuerpo: cuerpo — body (= cuerpo; perder el cuerpo 'to lose one's life')
dexaré: dexar — I shall leave, give up (future 1st sg.; dexaré el alma 'I shall give up the soul'; = dejaré)
tales: tal — such (pl., both genders; tales malcalçados 'such wretches'; = tales)
malcalçados: malcalçado — ill-shod, wretched, barefoot rabble (adj. as noun, masc. pl., mal + calçado; contemptuous; = malcalzados, harapientos)
vençieron: vençer — they defeated (preterite 3rd pl.; me vençieron de batalla 'defeated me in battle'; = vencieron)

__broaden__.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'has' before the participle in a split perfect with the object preceding (vençido a esta batalla 'has won this battle'; a preson le a tomado 'has taken him prisoner')
__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — 'for, because' (que a menos de batalla non pueden den quitar 'for they cannot get out of it without battle'); lo que 'that which' (que más vale de mill marcos, relative 'which')
__broaden__.ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca — 'for' introducing a reason (plogo a mio Çid, ca grandes son las ganancias 'it pleased the Cid, for the gains are great')
__broaden__.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — Pidal's lês = les es 'is to them' (venido lês mensaje 'a message has come to them')
__broaden__.sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.) · also 'let it be' as a hortatory subjunctive (aquí sea la batalla 'let the battle be here')
